speed, look ahead and help your Impreza automatically adjust
to keep your distance, even in stop-and-go traffic.

into another. EyeSight® watches for lane markers and chimes to
warn you before you leave your lane, and it can even help steer
you back into your proper course, thanks to Lane Keep Assist.

accidentally accelerating into the car in front of you while merging,
or if you unintentionally put your Impreza in Drive instead of Reverse.
